gold: Left maxillary giant cell reparative granuloma (GCRG)

selector.rationale: The presence of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components in the left maxillary sinus, along with significant sinus pressure and facial swelling, strongly supports Juvenile Nasopharyngeal Angiofibroma. The biopsy results showing a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells also align with this diagnosis, although they are not exclusive to it.

rejected.label: Fibrous Dysplasia
rejected.why: While bony changes and involvement of the maxillary alveolar ridge are consistent with Fibrous Dysplasia, the overall clinical and imaging findings more strongly support a soft tissue mass like Juvenile Nasopharyngeal Angiofibroma.

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis
rejected.why: The lack of specific findings indicative of vasculitis or granulomatous inflammation in the biopsy results and the clinical presentation makes Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis less likely.
